definitions.explanation: Containers (bottles, cans, boxes) and packaging (wrappers, films) used to hold or protect goods, considered collectively. Common term in recycling and waste-management regulation.

examples.japanese: {容器包装|ようきほうそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分別|ぶんべつ}→分別：07706_bunbetsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please separate containers and packaging when disposing of them.

examples.japanese: ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{容器包装|ようきほうそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧だ。
examples.english: Plastic containers and packaging are subject to recycling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{容器包装|ようきほうそう}リサイクル{法|ほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づき→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧、{再資源化|さいしげんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Under the Containers and Packaging Recycling Law, companies bear the cost of recycling.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧ (container) + ⟦{包装|ほうそう}→包装：11932_housou⟧ (packaging, wrapping). A standard term in Japanese environmental law and household recycling: the {容器包装|ようきほうそう}リサイクル{法|ほう} (Containers and Packaging Recycling Law) of 1995 established producer responsibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {容器包装|ようきほうそう}リサイクル{法|ほう}: Containers and Packaging Recycling Law
- ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧{容器包装|ようきほうそう}: plastic containers and packaging
- {容器包装|ようきほうそう}⟦{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}→廃棄物：04634_haikibutsu⟧: containers-and-packaging waste
- {容器包装|ようきほうそう}{材|ざい}: container and packaging materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦パッケージ→パッケージ：11699_pakkeeji⟧: package — loanword, more casual; refers to a single packaged unit
- ⟦{梱包|こんぽう}→梱包：07937_konpou⟧: packing, packaging — emphasizes the act of packaging for shipping
